initial_spec.task: Classify MLH1 missense variant p.Thr117Met in suspected Lynch syndrome family.
initial_assumptions: Missense change in conserved ATP-binding pocket of MLH1 ATPase domain

evidence_schedule.content: InSiGHT Guideline: Functional MMR in-vitro assay must demonstrate <10% repair activity and protein instability to score PS3.
Published functional assays (yeast MMR and mammalian 2-hybrid) both validated complete disruption of PMS2 heterodimerization and repair (<5% activity). PS3 is validated.
gnomAD update: Variant observed in 1 heterozygous elderly individual without cancer (AF = 0.000004), disallowing PM2_StandAlone but retaining PM2 as rare (<0.0001).

Multiple independent Lynch syndrome pedigrees confirm strong co-segregation with colorectal tumors showing microsatellite instability and loss of MLH1/PMS2 expression (PP1_Strong + PS4). Combined with functional defect (PS3) and ATP domain localization (PM1), variant reaches Pathogenic.

ground_truth.provenance: Well-established Lynch syndrome pathogenic mutation classified by InSiGHT Expert Panel.
